findings.claim: frank-projects contains 14 direct project roots, of which 11 are vehicle/camper search variants and three are other classes (research-agent, test-project, web launch page).
findings.implication: Application evidence must be deduplicated by capability family rather than project-name count.

findings.claim: The richer vehicle-search lineage contains persistent search/scoring code, data/results, logs, heartbeat state and alert templates, demonstrating a multi-step application pattern spanning acquisition, normalization, scoring, persistence, scheduling and reporting.
findings.implication: Use this as a historical application-shaped fixture for ClayCode general-purpose tests, not as proof that current ClayCode can already compile the workload.

findings.claim: An inspected autonomous vehicle-search setup explicitly left recurring market scan, reporting, dealer-contact and price-analysis heartbeats disabled pending approval even though their planned workflow was configured.
findings.implication: Preserve the separation between prepared automation and granted execution authority. Scheduling configuration is not authorization to perform external effects.

findings.claim: video-launch-page contains a concrete HTML artifact, browser-state evidence and a deployment skill, providing a non-agentic web-output class alongside the search-agent family.
findings.implication: ClayCode GENERAL_PURPOSE_GATE should include both persistent agent workflows and ordinary web artifact generation/deployment, preventing overfitting the language to FRANK-internal workloads.

findings.claim: An inspected setup report embeds credential-like plaintext while simultaneously describing the credentials as vaulted. Secret values are intentionally omitted from this receipt.
findings.implication: Archive assimilation and future UnifiedDB ingestion need a pre-write secret-detection/redaction boundary. Provenance may retain that a secret-bearing source existed, but the secret bytes must not be copied into public/shared research artifacts.

findings.claim: The inspected ai-research-agent code path contains only a small hello.py file, showing that project-directory existence and ambitious naming are not sufficient evidence of implemented capability.
findings.implication: Credit executable artifacts and verified outcomes, not folder names or planning documents.

earned_work_candidate.mechanism_or_result: Historical application corpus supplies non-greenfield acceptance fixtures for persistent search/scoring/scheduling/reporting workflows plus static web artifact generation, together with approval-boundary and anti-inflation negative cases.
earned_work_candidate.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: General-purpose ClayCode harness must translate these historical capability families into clean-room task contracts and show they distinguish real implementation from skeleton/project-name artifacts.

progress_accounting.reason: Root denominator is frozen but recursive per-project obligations remain open and Drive upload is still changing.
